# Coding Uncertainty

This folder addresses ambiguities in medical procedure registration, specifically focusing on how preoperative optimization is coded within the Danish healthcare system. It highlights documented uncertainties regarding whether the procedure code NAAZ42 can be legitimately applied when an anesthesiologist performs pre-optimization outside of designated units such as IMA or the ITA-afsnit. These coding inconsistencies are significant because they affect how hospital departments register anesthesiological assessments, potentially leading to divergent clinical data and billing discrepancies depending on the physical location of the optimization.

## Pages

- [[coding-uncertainty|Coding Uncertainty]] — Details the ambiguity surrounding the legitimate use of the NAAZ42 procedure code for preoperative anesthesiological assessments conducted outside standard intensive care units.
